beats.name: A. The street of signs
beats.blurb: Dusk, a terrace with every party's sign out front; someone wheels their bin out to the kerb.

beats.name: B. Into the bin
beats.blurb: Push in on the bin lid.

beats.name: C. Inside, looking up
beats.blurb: From inside the bin, looking up at the lid: the BadCode logo and name light up in it.
